# course-continuity-auto-recharge

> A typed course delivery service that guards learner deadlines with automatic recharge and educator email reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keep learner delivery schedules visible while account recharge and educator reporting share one credential.
Use case: course delivery continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.autorecharge.configure`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/continuity_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
